{
  "role": "code-review",
  "head": "13b553036716cb67df8f3de9b4ba0fbee5dc9089",
  "base": "ad92a0864ac56987a4896fd5770abab0c0c9b271",
  "verdict": "request_changes",
  "signal": "fail",
  "summary": "The native monitor can report that it finished a session while leaving tests unlocked, and its new browser smoke has unbounded operations. Current-head focused validation does not establish complete CI or project parity.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "path": "rewrite-app/apps/web/src/app/native-monitor/group-monitor/test-session-manager/test-session-manager.service.ts",
      "line": 371,
      "title": "Finish-all can succeed before the monitor has loaded its targets",
      "evidence": "Finish-all captures IDs from the currently rendered sessions. The finish button is enabled while the initial snapshot or Booklet enrichment is still pending, and also after a polling error. In those states the list can be empty or stale; an empty testIds array selects nothing, yet the lock and terminate requests can succeed and the component navigates back to the chooser. Tests omitted from that snapshot remain unlocked despite the confirmation promising to end every test.",
      "recommendation": "Obtain and validate a fresh, complete group snapshot before capturing finish targets, or disable the action until a successful complete snapshot is available and reject stale or failed reads. Add coverage for finishing during initial loading, slow material enrichment, and a failed or stale poll."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "path": "rewrite-app/scripts/smoke-native-monitor.mjs",
      "line": 49,
      "title": "Bound native smoke requests and server shutdown",
      "evidence": "The new required browser smoke uses fetch without a request or response-body deadline. Its final cleanup also waits indefinitely for the server to exit after SIGTERM. A stalled response or server shutdown can hang the standalone smoke and consume the CI job timeout rather than producing a bounded failure and cleanup.",
      "recommendation": "Apply the existing bounded smoke request and subprocess supervision patterns, including an absolute response-body deadline and a timed shutdown with escalation. Add a negative control for a stalled response and shutdown."
    }
  ],
  "verified": [
    "Confirmed the pinned HEAD and tree, inspected the committed diff and native monitor source, and compared relevant control behavior with the named Original checkout.",
    "Traced exact integer decoding and serialization, profile-claim routing, access-scope cancellation, polling, Booklet caching, and finish-all target selection.",
    "The older Goto context, slow Booklet enrichment, missing state-label, and pending-test finish findings have corresponding changes in the current source; they were not repeated as open findings.",
    "The supplied receipt identifies focused local frontend, lifecycle, typecheck, build, and headed browser results with the current head and tree. Its previous CI success or failure records belong to earlier commits; current-head CI is recorded as pending.",
    "The separate cache-environment receipt identifies its negative control as head 5d9ba6c670da7ed68aa42d0e0cdb4fddf2c7dd91 and does not establish current-head CI success."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "This was a read-only source review; broad suites and browser scenarios were not rerun.",
    "The repository Brain brief could not run because its lock directory could not be created in the read-only sandbox; direct source inspection was used instead.",
    "The supplied evidence does not establish complete current-head CI, broad visual parity, or whole-project parity."
  ]
}
